speaker: CHESHIRE
description: CHESHIRE should sound like: Eerie and ambiguous (neither clearly male nor female); Playful and cat-like meows; Arrogant, delighted, and proud tone when praised; High-pitched; Intersperses speech with meows; Unpredictable; Nonchalant; Narcissistic; Extremely susceptible to compliments and flattery; Playful.
ref_text: You look cute. Just to Alice’s liking. She’ll go crazy for you.
